t: Redstone mode determines how a redstone signal on the $(l:laserio:redstonechannel)Redstone Channel$(/l) will affect a card.$(br2)By default, this is set to $(bold)ingored$() which means the card will always operate, and redstone will not affect it.
红石模式决定给定$(l:laserio:redstonechannel)红石频道$(/l)上的红石信号如何影响该卡。$(br2)默认情况下，红石模式设为$(bold)忽略$()，也即物流卡会一直运行，不会受红石信号影响。

$(br2)If set to low, the cards will only function when there is NOT a redstone signal on the redstone channel (the channel button is to the right of the redstone toggle).$(br2)On redstone high mode, the cards will only operate when there IS a redstone signal on the redstone channel.
$(br2)若其设为“低”，则该卡仅会在其红石频道内$(l)无$()信号时工作。（红石频道按钮在红石模式按钮右侧。）$(br2)若其设为“高”，则该卡仅会在其红石频道内有信号时工作。
